title: Legend of the Virgin Mary landing on Athos at Iveron
summary: Ralph tells of Legend of the Virgin Mary landing on Athos at Iveron, about 1st century; told to him 2005-2007 at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: she got blown on the island of Monothos and there's a monastery on the placed on the site where she supposedly landed went ashore called Iveron

plain: A guest named Ralph, interviewed on a podcast that billed him as a former spy chief, says that while travelling in Greece in the mid-2000s a monk told him an old legend about Mount Athos, a Greek peninsula full of monasteries. According to the monk, the Virgin Mary was blown off course by the wind and came ashore there, and a monastery called Iveron now stands on the spot where she is said to have landed.
